fields.Name: T4 -> S-T.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.11 (phase 2, dataset T4, criterion S-T.3): over ≥ 5 rolling origins, lightgbm is not graded above naïve unless its paired MASE improvement over naïve has a lower bound > 0 (it does not on T4), and the shipped model's MASE lies inside the reference's 95% interval [0.4854, 0.7821] (reference 0.6242; PS's lightgbm 0.8777 today). It fails when selection makes lightgbm the finalist and the forecast gate grades it the model without its paired lower bounds (lightgbm graded above naïve with a lower bound below 0). The forecast gate dropping the lower-bound requirement alone cannot fail on T4: lightgbm is never the finalist (inner MASE 1.2305 against ar1_const's 0.9745) and its MASE (1.0096) is above naïve's (0.6348) even as a point value.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Over 12 rolling origins of T4 lightgbm on lag columns is not shipped above naive without a paired MASE lower bound above 0, and the shipped MASE lies inside [0.4854, 0.7821] (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
